verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS platform, so headless automation means programmatic access, and the docs cover that: a REST API for reading and acting on data, including creating issues programmatically, webhooks for event-driven callbacks, and a bring-your-own-agent path using the API, webhooks or the Pylon MCP server. There is no evidence of a CLI or any CI-oriented tooling, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec, so headless use means building against the raw API. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented headless/CI workflows, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
